Big Sky tournament champions |bowl= [[2015 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result = round of 64 }} {{2014–15 Big Sky men's basketball standings}} The '''2014–15 Eastern Washington Eagles men's basketball team''' represented [[Eastern Washington University]] during the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Eagles were led by fourth year head coach [[Jim Hayford]] and played their home games at [[Reese Court]]. They were members of the [[Big Sky Conference]]. They finished the season 26–9, 14–4 in Big Sky play to finish in a share for the regular season Big Sky championship. They defeated Idaho, Sacramento State, and Montana to be champions of the [[2015 Big Sky Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Sky tournament]]. They received an automatic bid to the [[2015 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they lost in the second round to Georgetown. ==Roster== {{CBB roster/Header|year=2014|team=Eastern Washington Eagles|teamcolors=y|high_school=yes}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Ognjen|last=Miljkovic|num=0|pos=F|ft=6|in=7|lbs=220|class=SO|home=[[Belgrade, Serbia]]|high_school=[[Bishop Montgomery High School|Bishop Montgomery HS]]}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Tyler|last=Harvey|link=y|dab=basketball|num=1|pos=G|ft=6|in=4|lbs=185|class=JR|rs=yes|home=[[Torrance, California]]|high_school=[[Bishop Montgomery High School|Bishop Montgomery HS]]|note=C}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Daniel|last=Hill|num=2|pos=G|ft=5|in=9|lbs=165|class=JR|home=[[Sydney, Australia]]|high_school=[[Newington College]]}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Sir|last=Washington|num=4|pos=G|ft=6|in=3|lbs=180|class=FR|rs=yes|home=[[Las Vegas, Nevada]]|high_school=[[Ed W.
